description.value:
You are standing slightly beside yourself, and have been for a while.

Gift — Once per day for 1 minute you occupy two places one step apart: attacks against you require a DC 6 flat check or strike the wrong one and miss entirely. Tithe — It occupies both Neural and Dermal — and you are not alone in there. Once per session the GM may act as the second shadow: it does something you would not have done, and you get no save.

cinderfall.incomplete: "Attacks against you require a DC 6 flat check or strike the wrong one and miss entirely" (once per day, 1 minute) has no rule-element equivalent: no selector exists for imposing a flat check on an attacker's own to-hit roll against this actor from a self-held item; the closest real mechanism (a miss-chance effect) is built into specific conditions like invisible, not exposed as a generic actor rule.
